comment: The frozen effect vocabulary for version 0. This file is the authority; event.schema.json repeats these names as enums so that a misspelled effect fails validation instead of silently doing nothing. Adding a name here is an engine decision, not a content decision, and belongs in docs/decisions.md.

grant_title.summary: Gives the named title to the target character.

kill_character.summary: Kills the target character on the day the event fires.

change_opinion.summary: Adds value to the target's opinion of the event root. Negative values lower it.

targets.root: The character the event fired on.
targets.holder: The holder of the title in question.
targets.primary_heir: The character who would inherit the root's primary title today.
